name: no_silent_drops
description: No Silent Drops oracle per spec appendix-bufferbloat.md B.2.5. Validates that packet drops are explicitly signaled via exceptions, return values, and logging.

requirements.implementation: QueueFullError exception from TxQueue.push() and ForwardingResult.BACKPRESSURE from ForwardingBuffer.try_buffer()
ICMPv6 Destination Unreachable (ADMIN_PROHIBITED) via make_resource_exhausted() helper
WARNING-level logging on all packet drops (backpressure, eviction, pending queue full)

vectors.name: tx_queue_full_raises_exception
vectors.description: TxQueue.push() raises QueueFullError when full and cannot preempt (explicit backpressure).

vectors.name: tx_queue_preemption_signals_reservation
vectors.description: Preempted packets signal their reservation with False (No Silent Drops).

vectors.name: tx_queue_expiry_signals_reservation
vectors.description: Expired packets signal their reservation with False (No Silent Drops).

vectors.name: tx_queue_clear_signals_reservations
vectors.description: TxQueue.clear() signals all pending reservations with False (No Silent Drops).

vectors.name: forwarding_buffer_backpressure_per_source
vectors.description: ForwardingBuffer returns BACKPRESSURE when per-source limit reached.

vectors.name: forwarding_buffer_eviction_logged
vectors.description: ForwardingBuffer eviction is logged at WARNING level for diagnostics.

vectors.name: icmpv6_resource_exhausted_nack
vectors.description: make_resource_exhausted() creates ICMPv6 DEST_UNREACHABLE with ADMIN_PROHIBITED code.

vectors.name: pending_queue_drop_logged
vectors.description: Pending queue drops oldest packet and logs at WARNING level.
